description: A map holding an empty and a non-empty list of lists fails for a parameter of nested dynamic lists
notes: The spec's type specification rules make map(list(list(string))) match map(list(list(dynamic))), since any type matches the dynamic pseudo-type, so the call should receive the map unchanged. hashicorp/hcl converts the argument with go-cty's convert.Convert (FunctionCallExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go), which converts each map element on its own: the empty list of element x becomes an empty list(list(dynamic)), because conversionCollectionToList (cty/convert/conversion_collection.go) gives an empty list the target element type when that isn't the dynamic pseudo-type itself, while element y stays a list(list(string)). Unifying the two (conversionUnifyCollectionElements) doesn't make their types equal, so the conversion fails.
reference_error: element types must all match for conversion to map
